title: Cross-layer unknown-record and paper-space writer boundaries
mode: Primary-source web research and read-only local plan crosswalk; plan-only
scope: Screen current CADCraft reports about unknown custom-object visibility/preservation and multi-layout DWG output.
Trace the reported loss boundaries across decoder diagnostics, retained raw data, serialization, and downstream reopen/consumer stages.
Refresh the status caveat for ACadRust issue #121 and separate its AC1015 read path from writer-side layout ownership/naming reports.
Refine existing PAR-06/PAR-49 implementation readiness without introducing external fixtures or required peer execution.

sources.revision: Issue, mutable main source view, and gap inventory reviewed 2026-10-20
sources.observed: Issue #1361 is open. A maintainer describes a DXF unknown-entity route that retains raw tags/proxy graphics but is not rendered by CADCraft, and a DWG→DXF route where ACadRust's DxfWriter reportedly drops EntityType::Unknown records without raw DXF codes. Current dwg_to_dxf_noted source obtains notes from failsafe reader stats, then performs DxfWriter serialization and adds selected cleanup notes; this separates read-skip diagnostics from writer emission accounting. The gap inventory says its then-current DWG route still drops custom-class content. This does not establish behavior in libdxfrw or every ACadRust release.

sources.project: CADCraft multi-layout writer and consumer route
sources.observed: Open issue #1463 describes a synthetic ezdxf-created three-layout DXF converted by CADCraft 0.7.0. Same-ACadRust readback retained reported per-layout counts, while ZWCAD 2025 placed non-active paper-space entities on the first layout. CADCraft PR #1080 merged Oct 19 and changes entity ownership/mode for non-active layout blocks. A later issue comment reports a separate duplicate *Paper_Space-name failure in ACadSharp 3.8.0 and says ODA File Converter opened the file. No attachments were downloaded and no peer/native results were reproduced.

sources.revision: Issue page and issue index reviewed 2026-10-20; commit page not independently fetched
sources.observed: Issue #121 is marked closed/completed against commit 8346596. Its body describes AC1015 multi-layout paper-space entities being assigned to the active layout because the reader discarded first/last entity ranges, while AC1032 behaved differently. Activity on the issue says closure was expected after the commit merged into main; the reviewed page does not establish release inclusion. Treat status as closed issue with merge/release provenance unresolved, not as current-release behavior.

planChanges: Do not treat parser skip/read diagnostics as writer-emission accounting; reconcile each known source identity through adapter retention, emitted record/carrier or explicit refusal, and post-write identity.
Treat proxy display graphics as a visual fallback channel, not as preservation of the custom object or its semantics.

For the next touched local multi-layout DWG writer slice, use a locally authored generated control that asserts unique reserved block names, layout-to-block-record identity, exact entity membership/mode, and a following model-space sentinel.

Keep the AC1015 first/last chain route separate from AC1018+ explicit-owner traversal and from writer-side entity-mode/name behavior; consult the authoritative ODA version branch before changing encoding.
Use same-codec reopen as internal consistency only; independent-reader and native acceptance remain at the existing composed checkpoint and do not block local slices.
limitations: CADCraft issue content and issue comments are maintainer/reporter evidence; no peer behavior was independently reproduced.
No external drawing attachments were downloaded, and no peer repository, executable, native CAD application, or kernel was run.
The ACadRust #143 follow-up issue was not retrievable in this review; its reported status remains unresolved.
The ACadRust #121 issue page marks the report closed but does not establish that commit 8346596 is included in a current released artifact.
No local code or tests were changed or run; this was a plan and research-receipt update only.
